textMode.instruction: Write ONE English clause naming a single concrete visual object or moment to paint as this game icon, plus exactly one saturated accent colour. Under 25 words. No style words, no lighting, no background, no framing — those are fixed elsewhere. No numbers, no game statistics, no proper nouns from real-world franchises. Answer with the clause only.
textMode.note: --subject=text 改用一次 /ai/text 呼叫產生主體句；PREFIX 與 NEGATIVE 永不外包。

nameNoun: a bloom of green healing motes
a bloom of green healing motes
itemArchetype: a legendary relic wreathed in power
abilityComposition: the instant of the strike, energy bursting toward the viewer
the instant of the strike, energy bursting toward the viewer
the instant of the strike, energy bursting toward the viewer
a still heraldic emblem glowing faintly from within

a silhouette caught mid-metamorphosis, dissolving into energy
a summoned creature's head and shoulders rising from smoke
a rune toggled bright against its dark twin
a translucent duplicate silhouette, ghosted and offset

rules.text: 名稱優先比對。曾經有一版先比對說明，把「妖狐變化」變成了 an impacting fist——因為制式用語「攻擊力」裡有個「擊」。
數字是機制不是視覺，比對前先被剝除。
任何中文機制敘述都不會被送進圖像模型。只有名稱以「」包起來、當作專有名詞送出。
NEGATIVE 明確禁止外框／浮雕／按鈕邊。已萃取的 113 張把 WC3 的邊框燒在圖裡，新生成的這一組刻意不跟。

contactSheet.note: 這 16 格是刻意挑出來會出問題的樣本，不是 16 張好看的圖。

slots.why: 說明過短或完全沒有可視覺化的名詞：詞庫沒命中，主體是 [tag] 的預設值。這格是用來檢查『最差的提示詞』畫出來還能不能看。

Fixed lighting: warm key light from the upper left at 45 degrees, cool cyan rim light down the lower-right edge, shadow pooling bottom-right. Background is a flat near-black void #0B0E16 with a single soft radial glow behind the subject and darkened corners. Muted steel, leather and bone base, lifted by exactly ONE saturated accent hue. Bold readable silhouette, high local contrast, chunky forms, no fine filigree. Painted to stay legible at 64 pixels. SUBJECT: a gout of flame, composed as a still heraldic emblem glowing faintly from within; the single accent hue is molten orange; this is the martial-arts technique known as 「火羽」. Negative: no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no signature; no border, no frame, no button bevel, no UI panel; no white or light background, no paper, no page drop-shadow; no collage, no multiple objects, no grid, no side-by-side variants; no photorealism, no 3D render, no studio product shot; no real-world brand or logo, no recognisable copyrighted character.

slots.why: 主動技能：構圖應該是命中的瞬間、能量朝觀者爆開。與上一格對照才看得出分流有沒有效。

神器

技能冷卻時間：60秒

效能

These are the published list prices as of the authoring model's Jan-2026
knowledge cutoff. Nothing in this repo can verify them — the runner prints
the rate it used and the date below on every dry run, and REFUSES to bill
unless --i-have-confirmed-pricing is passed, precisely so a stale number
here can never quietly become a real charge.
